마태복음 20:1.content: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.

마태복음 20:2.content: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

마태복음 20:3.content: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,

마태복음 20:4.content: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.

마태복음 20:5.content: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.

마태복음 20:6.content: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?

마태복음 20:7.content: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.

마태복음 20:8.content: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.

마태복음 20:9.content: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.

마태복음 20:10.content: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.

마태복음 20:11.content: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,

마태복음 20:12.content: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.

마태복음 20:13.content: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?

마태복음 20:14.content: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.

마태복음 20:15.content: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?

마태복음 20:16.content: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.

마태복음 20:17.content: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,

마태복음 20:18.content: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,

마태복음 20:19.content: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.

마태복음 20:20.content: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee’s children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.

마태복음 20:21.content: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.

마태복음 20:22.content: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.

마태복음 20:23.content: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.

마태복음 20:24.content: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.

마태복음 20:25.content: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.

마태복음 20:26.content: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;

마태복음 20:27.content: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:

마태복음 20:28.content: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

마태복음 20:29.content: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

마태복음 20:30.content: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

마태복음 20:31.content: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

마태복음 20:32.content: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?

마태복음 20:33.content: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

마태복음 20:34.content: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
